notes: Snapshot of rosters. Age is calculated from birthDate automatically. Stats are 1-150 ratings (see README for how each sport maps). 'comp' is a Gen 1 (#1-151) Pokemon comparison shown only after the puzzle ends.

athletes.name: Shohei Ohtani
athletes.bio: It is gifted in more ways than seems fair. Rivals study it from every angle and still can't find a weakness.

comp.name: Mew
comp.why: Said to know every move. Pitches and hits at an MVP level.

athletes.name: Aaron Judge
athletes.bio: A towering creature that leads quietly. When it makes contact, the ball travels a very long way.

comp.name: Machamp
comp.why: Pure, overwhelming power with the discipline to match.

athletes.name: Juan Soto
athletes.bio: It has a remarkable eye and rarely chases anything it doesn't like. Patient to a fault, it waits for its pitch.

comp.name: Starmie
comp.why: Its glowing core analyzes everything. Elite eye at the plate.

athletes.name: Mookie Betts
athletes.bio: Small in stature but able to master almost any role it's given. Its versatility makes it hard to pin down.

comp.name: Ditto
comp.why: Transforms into whatever the team needs: outfield, second base, shortstop.

athletes.name: Bobby Witt Jr.
athletes.bio: Blazing fast and smooth with the glove. Infielders hurry their throws when it bursts out of the box.

comp.name: Jolteon
comp.why: Speed charged with electricity, plus sharp defense.

athletes.name: Elly De La Cruz
athletes.bio: Raw, wild and electric. Its tools are so loud that every trip to the plate feels like an event.

comp.name: Electabuzz
comp.why: Wild, crackling, raw tools that light up any game.

athletes.name: Paul Skenes
athletes.bio: It overwhelms hitters with velocity and a pitch that seems to vanish. It reached the top of its kind remarkably quickly.

comp.name: Charizard
comp.why: Breathes fire. Becomes an ace almost instantly.

athletes.name: Garrett Crochet
athletes.bio: A tall left-hander that freezes hitters in place and piles up strikeouts inning after inning.

comp.name: Dewgong
comp.why: Sleek, cold, and thrives in a chilly northeastern home.

athletes.name: Vladimir Guerrero Jr.
athletes.bio: Sturdy and powerful, it smashes line drives and rarely swings through a pitch. Pitchers find no safe place to throw it.

comp.name: Golem
comp.why: A solid boulder that hits the ball like a rockslide.

athletes.name: Cal Raleigh
athletes.bio: It wears heavy armor all game, then trades it for a bat and hits with surprising power.

comp.name: Kangaskhan
comp.why: A tough, protective guardian of its pitching staff.

athletes.name: José Ramírez
athletes.bio: Compact and tireless, it hits from both sides and plays every inning like it's the last.

comp.name: Sandslash
comp.why: Compact, tough, and always digging in.

athletes.name: Francisco Lindor
athletes.bio: Behind a famous grin is a steady leader that handles a premium position and rarely leaves the lineup.

comp.name: Clefable
comp.why: Charming, beloved, and much tougher than it looks.

athletes.name: Corbin Carroll
athletes.bio: Small but fearless, it glides around the bases like a gust of wind.

comp.name: Pidgeot
comp.why: Swift flier that covers ground in a heartbeat.

athletes.name: Julio Rodríguez
athletes.bio: It patrols a huge stretch of grass and snatches fly balls out of the sky. Its energy is contagious.

comp.name: Aerodactyl
comp.why: An ancient sky predator that robs fly balls.

athletes.name: Fernando Tatis Jr.
athletes.bio: It plays with flair and swagger, with an arm that cuts down runners and a swing built for highlights.

comp.name: Arcanine
comp.why: Majestic, athletic, and fiery.

athletes.name: Gunnar Henderson
athletes.bio: A tall, smooth left-handed swing flows out of this young infielder like a current.

comp.name: Wartortle
comp.why: Smooth, powerful, and still evolving.

athletes.name: Bryce Harper
athletes.bio: It has carried enormous expectations since it was young. It thrives when the crowd is at its loudest.

comp.name: Moltres
comp.why: A legendary blaze that rises again in big moments.

athletes.name: Yordan Alvarez
athletes.bio: Huge and completely calm, it barely seems to move until the bat whips through the zone.

comp.name: Snorlax
comp.why: Enormous, relaxed, and devastating once it wakes up.

athletes.name: Ronald Acuña Jr.
athletes.bio: Every swing and every step crackles with energy. It can beat you with power or with its legs.

comp.name: Raichu
comp.why: Explosive power stored in a small, speedy frame.

athletes.name: Yoshinobu Yamamoto
athletes.bio: Not big for its role, but it commands a deep arsenal of pitches with pinpoint precision.

comp.name: Ninetales
comp.why: Each tail is a different pitch. Mystical and precise.

athletes.name: Kyle Tucker
athletes.bio: It patiently waits for a mistake, then punishes it with a short, efficient swing. It quietly does everything well on the field.

comp.name: Porygon
comp.why: Calculated and precise, it runs on pure efficiency.

athletes.name: Pete Alonso
athletes.bio: It launches towering blasts with a violent, all-or-nothing swing. Its sturdy frame almost never leaves the lineup.

comp.name: Nidoqueen
comp.why: Thick-bodied, durable, and packing a heavy punch.

athletes.name: Freddie Freeman
athletes.bio: Its graceful swing sprays line drives to every part of the field. Veteran instincts let it adjust to any pitch it sees.

comp.name: Horsea
comp.why: Smooth and steady, gliding through any current.

athletes.name: Manny Machado
athletes.bio: It smothers anything hit near it with a cannon arm and soft hands. Its fiery competitiveness makes it a feared opponent.

comp.name: Cubone
comp.why: Battle-hardened, fearless, and ready to swing its club.

athletes.name: Rafael Devers
athletes.bio: Its ferocious swing drives the ball out to every direction, even when it is fooled. Velocity only seems to energize it.

comp.name: Sandshrew
comp.why: Compact and sturdy, it strikes back with surprising force.

athletes.name: Kyle Schwarber
athletes.bio: It swings for the fences with frightening force, trading contact for colossal power. It works deep counts and draws plenty of walks.

comp.name: Voltorb
comp.why: When it connects, the result is a pure explosion.

athletes.name: Jackson Chourio
athletes.bio: It blends quick-twitch speed with surprising pop and is still growing into its talent. It runs down balls in the gaps with ease.

comp.name: Oddish
comp.why: A young sprout whose bloom is just beginning.

athletes.name: Corey Seager
athletes.bio: Its swing is long, smooth, and almost effortless, yet it drives the ball with authority. It thrives when the pressure rises.

comp.name: Tentacruel
comp.why: Graceful in motion, dangerous when it strikes.

athletes.name: Riley Greene
athletes.bio: It attacks hittable pitches with a powerful uppercut and keeps adding strength each season. It is still learning to tame its aggression.

comp.name: Weepinbell
comp.why: Mid-growth and steadily evolving into something bigger.

athletes.name: Ketel Marte
athletes.bio: It hits with equal force from both sides of the plate. Its loose, fluid stroke produces hard contact all over the field.

comp.name: Dugtrio
comp.why: It pops up from more than one side to strike.

athletes.name: Pete Crow-Armstrong
athletes.bio: It covers enormous ground in the outfield, gliding under drives that seem destined to fall. It plays with constant energy and swagger.

comp.name: Butterfree
comp.why: A nimble flier that owns the open sky.

athletes.name: Byron Buxton
athletes.bio: It combines blazing speed with explosive power in a lean frame. When healthy, it dominates games on both sides of the ball.

comp.name: Raticate
comp.why: Lightning quick with a surprisingly strong bite.

athletes.name: Nick Kurtz
athletes.bio: It shows rare patience for its age, waiting for its pitch before unleashing tremendous power. It is still growing into its towering frame.

comp.name: Poliwag
comp.why: Young and developing, with huge evolution ahead.

athletes.name: Zack Wheeler
athletes.bio: It pounds the zone with heat and a deep arsenal, pitching deep into games. Its steady demeanor rarely cracks.

comp.name: Shellder
comp.why: Armored, dependable, and very hard to crack.

athletes.name: Gerrit Cole
athletes.bio: It challenges hitters with high fastballs and sharp breaking pitches. It studies every opponent and attacks with a plan.

comp.name: Flareon
comp.why: Burning heat with a sharp, calculating mind.

athletes.name: Hunter Greene
athletes.bio: It unleashes some of the hardest fastballs imaginable from a smooth delivery. It is still learning to harness all that heat.

comp.name: Ponyta
comp.why: A young flame with blazing speed in its stride.

athletes.name: Josh Hader
athletes.bio: It hides the ball until the last instant with a low, slinging release. Hitters struggle to pick up its pitches late in games.

comp.name: Farfetch'd
comp.why: Crafty and unorthodox, wielding an unusual weapon.

athletes.name: Mason Miller
athletes.bio: It overpowers hitters with blistering fastballs and a wipeout slider. It enters late and simply refuses to be touched.

comp.name: Electrode
comp.why: Explosive power that detonates late in games.

athletes.name: Jacob deGrom
athletes.bio: It pairs searing velocity with pinpoint command from a fluid, athletic delivery. When it is healthy, few hitters can square it up.

comp.name: Rapidash
comp.why: Elegant, blazing fast, and breathtaking in motion.

athletes.name: Roki Sasaki
athletes.bio: It pairs a blazing fastball with a tumbling offering that vanishes beneath bats. It is still refining its command.

comp.name: Jigglypuff
comp.why: Its signature offering lulls hitters to sleep.

athletes.name: Mike Trout
athletes.bio: It does nearly everything on the diamond at an elite level, pairing towering power with a sharp eye. Few creatures have ever matched its complete toolkit.

comp.name: Tauros
comp.why: Strong, fast, and powerful in every direction.

athletes.name: Tarik Skubal
athletes.bio: It fires blazing heat and a fading changeup from the left side with icy composure. It attacks the zone relentlessly and rarely gives in.

comp.name: Articuno
comp.why: Majestic, rare, and icy cool under pressure.

athletes.name: Adley Rutschman
athletes.bio: It commands the game from behind the plate, guiding its pitchers with a calm, steady mind. It works long at-bats from both sides of the plate.

comp.name: Kadabra
comp.why: A keen mind that reads every situation.

athletes.name: Jackson Merrill
athletes.bio: It sprays line drives across the field with a quick, compact swing. It tracks balls in the outfield with instincts beyond its years.

comp.name: Bulbasaur
comp.why: Young, well-rounded, and still growing stronger.

athletes.name: Nolan Arenado
athletes.bio: It patrols its side of the infield with acrobatic dives and a rifle arm. Its tireless work ethic shows in every play it makes.

comp.name: Kingler
comp.why: Clamps onto everything hit its way with an iron grip.

athletes.name: Munetaka Murakami
athletes.bio: It swings with immense raw power, sending baseballs to rare distances. It accepts plenty of swing-and-miss in exchange for its towering blasts.

comp.name: Magmar
comp.why: Burning with raw, eruptive power.

athletes.name: Roman Anthony
athletes.bio: It shows remarkable patience at the plate, rarely chasing pitches outside the zone. Its smooth swing hints at much more power still to come.

comp.name: Ivysaur
comp.why: A growing talent with its bloom still ahead.

athletes.name: Josh Naylor
athletes.bio: It plays with fiery emotion and puts the ball in play with stubborn contact. It swipes bases far more often than its sturdy build suggests.

comp.name: Primeape
comp.why: Fiery, intense, and fueled by emotion.

athletes.name: Christian Yelich
athletes.bio: Its smooth, balanced swing sprays hard contact to every field. It still uses savvy instincts to steal extra bases.

comp.name: Golduck
comp.why: A smooth swimmer with sharp instincts.

athletes.name: Kiké Hernández
athletes.bio: It can play nearly anywhere on the field and seems to thrive when the stakes rise. Its playful energy lifts everyone around it.

comp.name: Diglett
comp.why: Pops up anywhere on the field, right when it's needed.

athletes.name: Nikola Jokić
athletes.bio: It looks slow and unbothered, yet it sees passing lanes no one else can. It rarely seems to break a sweat.

comp.name: Slowbro
comp.why: Looks sleepy, then bends the game with its mind.

athletes.name: Shai Gilgeous-Alexander
athletes.bio: It slips past defenders with herky-jerky footwork and calmly drains shots from the middle of the floor.

comp.name: Persian
comp.why: Sleek, stylish, and slips away from anyone.

athletes.name: Victor Wembanyama
athletes.bio: Impossibly tall with the moves of a much smaller creature. It swats shots from places that should not be possible.

comp.name: Mewtwo
comp.why: Like nothing the league has ever seen.

athletes.name: Luka Dončić
athletes.bio: It lulls defenders to sleep with a slow dribble, then steps back into a shot they never saw coming.

comp.name: Hypno
comp.why: Hypnotizes defenders before the step-back.

athletes.name: Stephen Curry
athletes.bio: It fires from absurd distances and changed how its whole species plays the game.

comp.name: Blastoise
comp.why: Long-range cannons that never stop firing.

athletes.name: Jayson Tatum
athletes.bio: A long, polished wing that scores from every level and defends several positions.

comp.name: Hitmonchan
comp.why: Polished technique and a complete set of moves.

athletes.name: Anthony Edwards

comp.name: Primeape
comp.why: Fiery energy and a fearless attitude.

athletes.name: Joel Embiid
athletes.bio: A massive post presence with a surprisingly soft touch. When healthy, it is nearly impossible to stop.

comp.name: Rhydon
comp.why: Massive, armored, and dominant near the basket.

athletes.name: Jalen Brunson
athletes.bio: Small for its role, it uses crafty, low-to-the-ground footwork to burrow into the paint.

comp.name: Marowak
comp.why: Undersized but gritty and battle-tested.

athletes.name: Donovan Mitchell
athletes.bio: Quick and explosive, it attacks the rim in a flash and can catch fire for huge scoring nights.

comp.name: Pikachu
comp.why: Small, electric, and a fan favorite.

athletes.name: Tyrese Haliburton
athletes.bio: It sends passes soaring across the court and seems to love the biggest moments.

comp.name: Fearow
comp.why: Long wingspan and sends the ball flying.

athletes.name: Cade Cunningham
athletes.bio: A big, unhurried floor general that controls the pace and grows stronger every season.

comp.name: Kadabra
comp.why: Already powerful and still on the way to its final form.

athletes.name: Jaylen Brown
athletes.bio: Muscular and relentless, it attacks the rim in straight lines and doesn't back down from contact.

comp.name: Machoke
comp.why: Strong, physical, and built to attack.

athletes.name: Devin Booker
athletes.bio: A silky shotmaker whose jumper flows like water, even in the hottest conditions.

comp.name: Golduck
comp.why: Smooth, skilled, and full of buckets.

athletes.name: Kevin Durant

comp.name: Gengar
comp.why: A ghostly scorer nobody can stop.

athletes.name: Paolo Banchero
athletes.bio: A strong young forward that plows through defenders on the way to the rim.

comp.name: Nidorino
comp.why: Powerful and still evolving into a king.

athletes.name: Bam Adebayo
athletes.bio: It can guard almost anyone on the floor, from tiny guards to giant centers.

comp.name: Cloyster
comp.why: An almost impenetrable defensive shell.

athletes.name: Chet Holmgren
athletes.bio: Its long, wiry frame erases shots at the rim, and it can also step out and shoot from deep.

comp.name: Onix
comp.why: Long, slender, and blocks everything in its path.

athletes.name: Cooper Flagg
athletes.bio: A young prodigy that already does a bit of everything. Experts say it is only beginning to grow.

comp.name: Dratini
comp.why: Rare young talent destined to become a superstar.

athletes.name: Karl-Anthony Towns
athletes.bio: A big creature that floats out to the perimeter and shoots like a guard.

comp.name: Lapras
comp.why: A gentle giant that glides across the water.

athletes.name: Klay Thompson
athletes.bio: A pure catch-and-shoot marksman. Once it heats up, nothing can cool it down.

comp.name: Psyduck
comp.why: Seems laid-back, then erupts with sudden, unstoppable power.

athletes.name: LeBron James
athletes.bio: It reads the whole floor like an open book and bends every possession to its will. Its blend of power, vision and stamina has barely faded with time.

comp.name: Machamp
comp.why: Strong, tireless, and able to do everything at once.

athletes.name: Giannis Antetokounmpo
athletes.bio: It covers the length of the floor in just a few enormous strides and crashes into the rim with overwhelming force. Rivals build walls in the paint, and it plows through them anyway.

comp.name: Gyarados
comp.why: Grew into a towering, unstoppable force of nature.

athletes.name: Ja Morant
athletes.bio: It darts into the lane at blinding speed and launches itself toward the rim with no fear of the giants waiting there. Its acrobatic finishes seem to defy gravity.

comp.name: Pidgeotto
comp.why: Swoops in from above with fearless, high-flying attacks.

athletes.name: Kawhi Leonard
athletes.bio: It rarely makes a sound, yet its enormous hands smother anything it guards. In tense moments it calmly rises for a midrange shot that seldom misses.

comp.name: Magnemite
comp.why: Quiet, steely, and grips onto its target like a magnet.

athletes.name: Trae Young
athletes.bio: It fires shots from far beyond where defenders dare to venture and threads passes through the tiniest gaps. Its floaters drift over taller foes like falling feathers.

comp.name: Vulpix
comp.why: Small, clever, and full of fiery tricks.

athletes.name: Anthony Davis
athletes.bio: It patrols the paint with long arms that swat away anything near the rim. On offense it scores from the post, the elbow and above the rim with equal ease.

comp.name: Exeggutor
comp.why: Tall and towering, it looms over everything below.

athletes.name: James Harden
athletes.bio: It lulls defenders with an unhurried rhythm, then hops backward into a shot or bursts past them in a flash. Its deceptive moves constantly bait opponents into fouls.

comp.name: Venomoth
comp.why: Its dizzying moves leave foes disoriented.

athletes.name: LaMelo Ball
athletes.bio: It flings no-look passes across the floor and pulls up from deep without hesitation. Crowds roar whenever it pushes the pace upcourt.

comp.name: Seel
comp.why: A playful showman with a flair for dazzling tricks.

athletes.name: Paul George
athletes.bio: Its jumper flows with effortless, fluid motion from any spot on the floor. Long arms make it a menace in passing lanes on the other end.

comp.name: Seaking
comp.why: Graceful and elegant, with a sharp edge when needed.

athletes.name: Tyrese Maxey
athletes.bio: It streaks from end to end faster than anyone can follow and never seems to tire. Its bright, cheerful energy lifts everyone around it.

comp.name: Squirtle
comp.why: Cheerful, speedy, and beloved by all.

athletes.name: Zion Williamson
athletes.bio: It bursts toward the rim with a rare mix of raw strength and springy lift. Defenders in its path tend to bounce right off.

comp.name: Krabby
comp.why: A compact powerhouse with crushing strength.

athletes.name: De'Aaron Fox
athletes.bio: It slices into the lane with a first step few can match. When the game tightens, it stays calm and demands the ball.

comp.name: Growlithe
comp.why: Loyal, fearless, and lightning fast on its feet.

athletes.name: Jalen Williams
athletes.bio: It glides into the midrange with patient, powerful drives and guards the opponent's best scorer on the other end. It keeps adding new skills each time it is observed.

comp.name: Paras
comp.why: Steady and resilient, it keeps growing stronger.

athletes.name: Alperen Şengün
athletes.bio: It spins, pivots and fakes its way around the post with old-fashioned footwork. From the high post it whips clever passes to cutters no one else sees.

comp.name: Kabuto
comp.why: Its old-school moves seem pulled from an ancient era.

athletes.name: Jaren Jackson Jr.
athletes.bio: It erases shots at the rim with long, lightning-quick arms, then drifts out to knock down jumpers from deep. Its odd shooting form still finds the net.

comp.name: Tentacool
comp.why: Long reaching arms that sting anything nearby.

athletes.name: Kyrie Irving
athletes.bio: Its dribble moves are so slippery that defenders lose track of the ball entirely. It finishes around the rim at angles that seem impossible.

comp.name: Ekans
comp.why: Slithers through tight spaces and strikes in a flash.

athletes.name: Jamal Murray
athletes.bio: It can go quiet for stretches, then erupt for a barrage of tough jumpers. It thrives in the two-man game with a trusted partner.

comp.name: Nidorina
comp.why: Calm and composed, it strikes when it matters most.

athletes.name: Draymond Green
athletes.bio: It barks out orders and seems to be guarding every opponent at once. Its constant chatter and physical style get under rivals' skin.

comp.name: Golbat
comp.why: Relentless and pesky, it never leaves foes alone.

athletes.name: Evan Mobley
athletes.bio: Its long limbs let it switch onto guards and still recover to block shots at the rim. Its offensive game is still sprouting new branches.

comp.name: Tangela
comp.why: Its long vines seem to reach everywhere at once.

athletes.name: Darius Garland
athletes.bio: It weaves through screens with a loose, slippery handle and pulls up for silky jumpers. Its slight frame hides a quick and clever mind.

comp.name: Bellsprout
comp.why: Slender and whip-quick, it slips past bigger foes.

athletes.name: Jimmy Butler
athletes.bio: It bullies its way to the line with relentless physicality and refuses to back down from any challenge. The tighter the moment, the more it seems to relish it.

comp.name: Poliwrath
comp.why: A tough, relentless fighter that never backs down.

athletes.name: Damian Lillard
athletes.bio: It pulls up from far beyond the arc without blinking and seems to grow colder as the clock winds down. Defenders must pick it up the moment it crosses half court.

comp.name: Dewgong
comp.why: Calm and icy, it thrives in frigid moments.

athletes.name: Scottie Barnes
athletes.bio: It handles, passes, rebounds and defends with a long frame and a cheerful motor. Its game keeps branching out into new skills.

comp.name: Ivysaur
comp.why: Versatile and still blossoming into its full form.

athletes.name: Domantas Sabonis
athletes.bio: It plants its sturdy body at the elbow and runs the offense through dribble handoffs and sharp passes. Few creatures gather more loose rebounds.

comp.name: Rhyhorn
comp.why: Sturdy and steady, it charges straight into the paint.

athletes.name: Rudy Gobert
athletes.bio: It stands guard beneath the basket like a towering wall, swatting and altering every shot nearby. On offense it mostly lurks for lobs and putbacks.

comp.name: Golem
comp.why: A towering wall of rock beneath the rim.

athletes.name: Amen Thompson
athletes.bio: Its explosive speed lets it smother ball handlers and then race the other way before anyone can react. Its jumper is still a work in progress, but its athleticism is off the charts.

comp.name: Jolteon
comp.why: Crackling speed with sharp, prickly defense.

athletes.name: Dylan Harper
athletes.bio: It uses a strong frame and patient footwork to bump defenders off balance on drives. It is still young, and its craft grows more polished with every outing.

comp.name: Bulbasaur
comp.why: Young and sturdy, with plenty of growth ahead.

athletes.name: Austin Reaves
athletes.bio: It uses clever pump fakes and changes of pace to draw fouls from bigger, faster rivals. Crowds adore its fearless, crafty style.

comp.name: Clefairy
comp.why: A crowd favorite with more tricks than it lets on.

athletes.name: Pascal Siakam

comp.name: Rapidash
comp.why: Long, fluid strides carry it across open ground.

athletes.name: Patrick Mahomes
athletes.bio: It throws from any angle, on the run, sometimes without even looking. Defenses never feel safe.

athletes.name: Josh Allen

comp.name: Tauros

athletes.bio: It clamps onto quarterbacks with a relentless motor and plays every snap like it's personal.

comp.name: Pinsir
comp.why: Crushing grip that wraps up quarterbacks.

athletes.name: Patrick Surtain II
athletes.bio: It shadows the opponent's best receiver every week and sticks to him like a magnet.

comp.name: Magneton
comp.why: Locks on and won't let go.

athletes.name: Brandon Aubrey
athletes.bio: It drills kicks from extremely long range with ice in its veins.

comp.name: Hitmonlee
comp.why: The legendary kicking specialist.

athletes.name: Drake Maye
athletes.bio: It grows more dangerous every week, flinging deep strikes with a powerful arm. When the pocket collapses, it takes off and runs with surprising speed.

comp.name: Nidoran♂
comp.why: Young, bold, and growing into royalty.

athletes.name: Jayden Daniels
athletes.bio: It glides away from pressure in a blur, then delivers throws with an eerie calm. Defenses must guard against its legs and its arm on every snap.

comp.name: Doduo
comp.why: Two heads, two threats: it runs and it throws.

athletes.name: Caleb Williams
athletes.bio: It slips out of collapsing pockets and fires passes from impossible arm angles. The wilder the play breaks down, the more it seems to enjoy itself.

comp.name: Meowth
comp.why: Crafty, showy, and always lands on its feet.

athletes.name: Jordan Love
athletes.bio: It flicks the ball downfield with an easy, fluid motion. When it gets hot, it threads tight windows without hesitation.

comp.name: Goldeen
comp.why: Graceful in motion with a sharp point.

athletes.name: Bo Nix
athletes.bio: It gets the ball out in a flash and grinds defenses down with quick, sure throws. When a lane opens, it tucks the ball and battles for extra ground.

comp.name: Spearow
comp.why: Feisty, scrappy, and quick to strike.

athletes.name: C.J. Stroud
athletes.bio: It stands tall in the pocket and places throws with pinpoint touch. It reads the coverage early and calmly finds the open target.

comp.name: Drowzee
comp.why: Reads what is coming before it happens.

athletes.name: Jaxson Dart
athletes.bio: A young passer that plays with a linebacker's attitude, lowering its shoulder instead of sliding. It keeps growing more poised as it learns.

comp.name: Cubone
comp.why: Young, tough, and swings away fearlessly.

athletes.name: Baker Mayfield
athletes.bio: It plays with a fiery edge and loves to rattle opponents. Even under heavy pressure, it scrambles around and hurls the ball downfield.

comp.name: Raticate
comp.why: Gritty, fearless, and always bites back.

athletes.name: Shedeur Sanders
athletes.bio: It hangs in the pocket with total composure and a showman's confidence. It prefers to beat defenses with timing and touch rather than speed.

comp.name: Vulpix
comp.why: Cool, stylish, and composed under heat.

athletes.name: Justin Herbert
athletes.bio: A towering passer with one of the strongest arms around. It shrugs off rushers and still launches lasers to every part of the field.

comp.name: Charmeleon
comp.why: A fiery arm inside a big, sturdy frame.

athletes.name: Jared Goff
athletes.bio: It thrives on timing and rhythm, delivering the ball on schedule to wide-open targets. It rarely leaves the pocket, preferring to win with anticipation.

comp.name: Vileplume
comp.why: Blossomed fully once planted in the right garden.

athletes.name: Cam Ward
athletes.bio: A young passer with a loose, live arm that can whip throws from any angle. It loves to improvise once the play breaks down.

comp.name: Squirtle
comp.why: A cool young starter with confident swagger.

athletes.name: Aaron Rodgers
athletes.bio: A veteran mastermind that baits defenses with hard counts and quick snaps. Its feet have slowed, but its mind and touch remain razor sharp.

comp.name: Omanyte
comp.why: A timeless survivor with old-school wisdom.

athletes.name: Sam Darnold
athletes.bio: It throws with a smooth, natural motion and attacks all levels of the field. It moves well enough to buy time and keep plays alive.

comp.name: Pidgey
comp.why: A humble flier that keeps rising higher.

athletes.name: Jahmyr Gibbs
athletes.bio: It hits the hole in a flash and is gone before defenders can react. Out of the backfield, it catches passes like a receiver and turns them into sprints.

comp.name: Voltorb
comp.why: Explodes into the open in a flash.

athletes.name: George Kittle
athletes.bio: It blocks with joyful violence and celebrates every pancake. When it catches the ball, it rumbles through tacklers with surprising speed.

comp.name: Nidoqueen
comp.why: Sturdy, powerful, and protective of its teammates.

athletes.name: Travis Kelce
athletes.bio: It drifts into soft spots in coverage as if it can read the defense's mind. Its charisma lights up the field as much as its sure hands.

comp.name: Wigglytuff
comp.why: A crowd-pleaser that loves the spotlight.

athletes.name: Ashton Jeanty
athletes.bio: Low to the ground and rock solid, it bounces off tacklers who try to arm-tackle it. It can cut sharply and burst away just when it looks stopped.

comp.name: Geodude
comp.why: Built like a boulder and nearly impossible to bring down.

athletes.name: Cam Skattebo
athletes.bio: A compact, wild-hearted runner that seeks out contact rather than avoiding it. It churns its legs through piles and drags defenders for extra yards.

comp.name: Sandshrew
comp.why: Compact, tough, and rolls right through contact.

athletes.name: Malik Nabers
athletes.bio: It snatches the ball with strong hands and instantly turns upfield. Once it has the ball, it bursts away or bullies through arm tackles.

comp.name: Pidgeotto
comp.why: A fierce young flier that snatches prey mid-air.

athletes.name: Tyreek Hill
athletes.bio: Its acceleration is so extreme that defenders give it a huge cushion and still lose. A single short catch can become a footrace it always wins.

comp.name: Dugtrio
comp.why: Blinding speed that leaves everyone in the dust.

athletes.name: Mike Evans
athletes.bio: A towering target that wins jump balls against smaller defenders. In the end zone, it simply rises up and plucks the ball from the air.

comp.name: Victreebel
comp.why: Its long reach swallows anything that comes near.

athletes.name: Cooper Kupp
athletes.bio: It wins with craft rather than speed, setting up defenders with subtle fakes. It always seems to know exactly where the soft spot in the zone will be.

comp.name: Chansey
comp.why: Dependable and always there when needed.

athletes.name: Travis Hunter
athletes.bio: A rare creature equally comfortable catching passes and breaking them up. Its smooth athleticism lets it adapt to almost any role it's given.

comp.name: Porygon
comp.why: Adapts to any role it's programmed for.

athletes.name: DK Metcalf
athletes.bio: A massively muscled receiver with sprinter's speed. It bullies cornerbacks at the line, then runs right past them down the sideline.

comp.name: Machop
comp.why: A muscle-bound powerhouse that loves to compete.

athletes.name: A.J. Brown
athletes.bio: A thickly built receiver that wins contested catches with strength. After the catch, it stiff-arms defenders and rumbles away for big gains.

comp.name: Krabby
comp.why: A crushing grip and a bruiser's strength.

athletes.name: Micah Parsons
athletes.bio: An explosive pass rusher with rare burst off the snap. It can line up anywhere and arrives at the quarterback in a flash.

comp.name: Golbat
comp.why: Swoops in fast and never lets its target escape.

athletes.name: T.J. Watt
athletes.bio: It never stops chasing, bending around blockers with a relentless motor. When it reaches the passer, it rips at the ball as well as the body.

comp.name: Venonat
comp.why: Relentless and always locked onto its target.

athletes.name: Cooper DeJean
athletes.bio: A versatile defender that covers the slot, tackles like a safety and pounces on errant throws. It always seems to be in the right place.

comp.name: Exeggcute
comp.why: Several minds at once; it is everywhere.

athletes.name: Fred Warner
athletes.bio: A rangy linebacker that diagnoses plays instantly and covers ground from sideline to sideline. It is just as comfortable shadowing receivers as stuffing runs.

comp.name: Venomoth
comp.why: Sees everything and covers ground in a flash.

athletes.name: Maxx Crosby
athletes.bio: It plays every snap at full throttle and never gives up on a play. It loves to get under opponents' skin as it hunts them down.

comp.name: Nidoran♀
comp.why: Sharp barbs and a fearless, never-quit spirit.

athletes.name: Nick Bosa
athletes.bio: A technician off the edge whose hands work faster than blockers can react. It swats, rips and dips its way to the quarterback with precision.

comp.name: Tentacruel
comp.why: Its many limbs work like skilled, precise hands.

athletes.name: Connor McDavid
athletes.bio: It carries the puck at blinding speed, leaving defenders frozen in its wake.

comp.name: Zapdos
comp.why: A legendary bolt of lightning.

athletes.name: Leon Draisaitl
athletes.bio: A big, strong centre with a one-timer that slices through goalies.

comp.name: Kabutops
comp.why: Slashing blades and a lethal shot.

athletes.name: Nathan MacKinnon
athletes.bio: It burns with intensity, and each rush builds like a fire racing downhill.

comp.name: Magmar
comp.why: Burning intensity on every shift.

athletes.name: Auston Matthews
athletes.bio: A feared sniper with a quick, deceptive release that fools goalies.

comp.name: Seadra
comp.why: Fires shots with pinpoint accuracy.

athletes.name: Sidney Crosby
athletes.bio: A complete, ageless leader that does everything well at both ends of the ice.

comp.name: Venusaur
comp.why: A fully evolved original that never fades.

athletes.name: Nikita Kucherov
athletes.bio: Quiet and mysterious, it disguises every pass as a shot and every shot as a pass.

comp.name: Mr. Mime
comp.why: Master of illusions with the puck.

athletes.name: Cale Makar
athletes.bio: It skates so smoothly that it seems to melt into the ice. A defender that attacks like a forward.

comp.name: Vaporeon
comp.why: So fluid it seems to dissolve into the ice.

athletes.name: Kirill Kaprizov
athletes.bio: It appears out of nowhere in front of the net, scores, and vanishes again.

comp.name: Gastly
comp.why: A sneaky phantom that pops up to score.

athletes.name: David Pastrňák
athletes.bio: Playful and goofy away from the rink, but its one-timer is no joke.

comp.name: Clefairy
comp.why: Playful and beloved, with surprising power.

athletes.name: Jack Hughes
athletes.bio: Its edgework is so slick that defenders often end up skating the wrong way.

comp.name: Ponyta
comp.why: Young, fast, and full of fire.

athletes.name: Connor Bedard
athletes.bio: A young prodigy with a lightning-quick release that keeps growing stronger.

comp.name: Charmander
comp.why: Young flame destined to become something huge.

athletes.name: Igor Shesterkin
athletes.bio: It guards the net with lightning reflexes and a hard shell.

comp.name: Omastar
comp.why: Hard shell and lightning-quick tentacles.

athletes.name: Andrei Vasilevskiy
athletes.bio: A huge presence in the crease that seems to fill the entire net.

comp.name: Graveler
comp.why: A rock-solid wall that doesn't move.

athletes.name: Matthew Tkachuk
athletes.bio: It gets under opponents' skin, chirping all game until they snap.

comp.name: Arbok
comp.why: An intimidating pest that wears you down.

athletes.name: Brady Tkachuk
athletes.bio: It parks itself in front of the net and refuses to be moved.

comp.name: Mankey
comp.why: Quick to anger and always ready to fight.

athletes.name: Mitch Marner
athletes.bio: It threads passes through tiny gaps that seem impossible.

comp.name: Abra
comp.why: Teleports the puck to open teammates.

athletes.name: Jack Eichel
athletes.bio: A big, complete centre that does a bit of everything.

comp.name: Dodrio
comp.why: Three heads, three skills, all at once.

athletes.name: Zach Werenski
athletes.bio: It logs huge minutes and pushes the play forward like a rising tide.

comp.name: Poliwhirl
comp.why: A tireless swimmer that never leaves the water.

athletes.name: Macklin Celebrini
athletes.bio: A young leader growing into a cornerstone faster than anyone expected.

comp.name: Ivysaur
comp.why: Rapidly growing toward its final form.

athletes.name: Kyle Connor
athletes.bio: Quiet and steady, it piles up goals with a release smooth as a stream.

comp.name: Staryu
comp.why: Quiet, steady, and always on target.
